review_comment: Potential command injection vulnerability: the 'async_run' function constructs the system command using 'os.system' with command-line arguments joined using ' '. This can be exploited if any of the arguments are untrusted user input, allowing an attacker to inject shell commands.

Exception handling vulnerability: Generic exception handler catches all exceptions, potentially masking serious issues in initialization (including security-related problems) instead of failing fast when a critical issue occurs.
